text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I walk into the cafeteria and spot Nakayama Festa talking to Eishin Flash rather conspiratorially.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, Flash. Have you wisened up about you-know-what?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Nakayama. I appreciate the invitation, but I cannot accept your offer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I am curious, however. Why me? I'm sure there are others who would be happy to play poker with you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: True… But finding a gambler with ice in their veins like you doesn't happen every day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I wanna see what it'll take to shatter that ice when the chips're down.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Apologies, but taking part in luck-based contests goes against my principles.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Meh, figured. People like you don't make a move unless the odds are in their favor.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But that's also what holds you back. I bet you freeze up and panic when faced with an all-or-nothin' battle, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh? You sure sound confident. Not that I'd believe you unless you've got somethin' to back up your words with.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Then again, you're her trainer. You two are birds of a feather—of course you'd back her up. But, well, I won't force you to do anything you don't wanna do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sweet. These chocolate coins'll serve as our chips. Now do your worst.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Tough luck. This round goes to me again. Maybe you'll do better next time, eh, buddy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've already lost eight times in a row. My palms are sweating like mad, and Nakayama Festa has full control of the situation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Wait. This has gone on long enough. Why continue this contest?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Why? 'Cause your trainer's still rarin' to go, for one thing. For another, our prides are on the line here. So's yours, for that matter.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Very well. Then I shall take that pride upon my shoulders and join the battle myself.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh… Now yer talkin'!
choice_data_list: If anyone can beat her, it's you!
If anyone can beat her, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh… Now yer talkin'!
choice_data_list: If anyone can beat her, it's you!
If anyone can beat her, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will not disappoint. Your pride shall survive this day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The game begins with both of them wearing perfectly stoic poker faces. Neither of them relent in their fierce back-and-forth showdown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Your straight trumps my set of sixes… I lose this round.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We're gettin' nowhere, taking turns winning an' losing like this. This's about the time I'd like to settle things with the final round…

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But we've really been in the long haul for this, and I'm gettin' kinda thirsty.
choice_data_list: I can get you some drinks.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You offerin'? Well, I won't say no to that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go get some tea from the drink dispenser, and by the time I return, they've already started the next hand.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoops.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa's elbow slips, and I happen to see that she has four jacks in her hand!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Saw my hand, didja?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm shaken when I see how strong her hand is. My eyes dart straight over to Flash.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Y'know what? I'm goin' all in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Here it is, the big moment fer all the marbles. So… ya gonna turn tail and run?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No. If you are going to face me head-on, then I shall accept your challenge and place my pride on the line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh… Hahaha! So you're gonna stick to your guns even at the eleventh hour, eh? I like the cut of your jib! C'mon, then! Let's settle the score!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They open their hands simultaneously, and Eishin Flash reveals her four kings! She's won by the skin of her teeth!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I lost, eh? Hehehe. I ain't mad, though. That was a helluva ride. You're good… Real good.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We should do this again sometime. Races're great an' all, but a little competition at the card table once in a while'd be fun too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I would prefer all our clashes to be on the track, but… Hehe. You're right that this was quite the intense battle.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Understood. I will do my best to redeem our honor!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh… Playin' with fire when you're not used to the heat'll only get you burnt.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I've got a full house. You?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A straight! I lost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa mercilessly keeps up the pressure, and the battle progresses as she said it would.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're gettin' a little flustered there. I knew it was only a matter of time before you started crackin'. Won't be long till you get burnt.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: This is goin' great, though, eh? I was hopin' to see what you looked like under pressure, and here we are. I'll bet.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? C'mon, freak out more! Go on and try to struggle outta the corner I've trapped you in!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Or are ya gonna give up and turn tail? Is this all you and your trainer've got?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Raise! I—I will go all in on this hand!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't kill the moment. …I like your style. Let's see what your final struggle's like!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But, once the cards come down…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Straight flush. I am victorious.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: …Heh. You played me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That was one helluva bluff you had goin' on there, squirmin' like fish bait till you knew you had a winnin' hand. Damn. You're good.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was nothing so nefarious. I merely stayed true to my strategy and didn't stray from my plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Are you displeased with my methods?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, nah! You put up a better fight than I ever expected.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You've got spunk, and I like that. I look forward to facing off against you again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: As do I. Though I would prefer our next showdown to be on the track. Hehe.
